# Which changed files make a pull request worth a Claude Security scan.
# Read by scripts/securityscan.go (see openspec/specs/security-scan-gate once archived).
#
# One glob per line. "**" crosses directories, "*" stays within one; a glob
# with no "/" matches the file name in any directory. A leading "!" names files
# that do NOT need a scan. For each changed file the LAST matching line wins,
# and a file that no line matches is scanned, so a new kind of file errs towards
# scanning. The pull request is scanned if any changed file needs it.
#
# Changing this file is itself a scan (.github/** is listed below).

# Code that handles untrusted input or the network
*.go
web/src/**

# Build, release and the container image
Dockerfile
.dockerignore
.goreleaser.yaml
.github/**

# Dependencies and the files that feed the build
go.mod
go.sum
web/package.json
web/package-lock.json
web/vite.config.ts
mappings/**
notices/**

# Files that configure Claude, which a pull request could use to steer a scan
.claude/**
CLAUDE.md
.mcp.json
.claude.json

# Exceptions: these never need a scan on their own
!*_test.go
!testdata/**
!web/src/test/**
!web/src/**/*.test.ts
!web/src/**/*.test.tsx
!openspec/**
!docs/**
!site/**
!README.md
!LICENSE
